---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with agree-first
---

Before filing: if this may be a security vulnerability, **do not post details here**. Use the [private reporting route](https://github.com/felipecepluki/agree-first/security/advisories) described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/felipecepluki/agree-first/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## What happened?

Describe the behavior and what you expected instead.

## How can we reproduce it?

Provide a small reproduction or clear steps. Include whether you use the link-only or review flow, and the relevant props (especially document URLs/versions, `previousPayload`, `storageKey`, and `requireScroll`). Remove personal data and secrets.

## Environment

- agree-first version:
- React and React DOM versions:
- Browser and operating system:
- Styling: default CSS / `unstyled` / custom classes:

## Additional context

Screenshots, console errors, or accessibility details if relevant.
